verified_facts.text: The Grand Hotel Zermatterhof lies at the very heart of Zermatt.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grand Hotel Zermatterhof lies at the very heart of Zermatt and is host to royalty, Hollywood celebrities and mountaineers.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has hosted royalty, Hollywood celebrities and mountaineers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grand Hotel Zermatterhof lies at the very heart of Zermatt and is host to royalty, Hollywood celebrities and mountaineers.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has views of the Matterhorn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steeped in history with views of the Matterhorn

verified_facts.text: The families of Zermatt built the hotel, originally the Hotel Zermatt, as a community project.
verified_facts.excerpt: The families of Zermatt build the Hotel Zermatt as a community project in order not to inflict huge debt on the local community.

verified_facts.text: Since 1920 the Burgergemeinde, Zermatt's burgher council, has run the hotel itself.
verified_facts.excerpt: As of 1920 the Burgergemeinde (burgher council) runs the hotel itself come rain or shine.

verified_facts.text: Every year on Corpus Christi day the hotel holds a traditional reception with local wine for the community.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every year on Corpus Christi day, the most important religious day of the year, the Zermatterhof prepares a traditional reception with local wine to the community.

verified_facts.text: Walt Disney is among the guests the hotel has hosted.
verified_facts.excerpt: Over the years guests from the world of politics, industry, art and showbusiness such as Walt Disney appreciate the absolute discretion the safe haven Zermatterhof offers.

verified_facts.text: Local man Martin Julen, a waiter at the Zermatterhof, won the Swiss Alpine Ski championship in 1951.
verified_facts.excerpt: Local boy Martin Julen is a waiter at the Zermatterhof and wins the Swiss Alpine Ski championship in 1951.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 10-minute walk from Zermatt station.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from the station.

verified_facts.text: The Vita Borni Alpine Wellness spa opened in December 2025 with a fitness centre, swimming pool, two jacuzzis with Matterhorn views, sauna, sanarium, steam bath, experience showers and an ice fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Das im Dezember 2025 neu eröffnete Spa bietet ein Fitnesscenter, Schwimmbad, zwei Jacuzzis mit Matterhornblick, Sauna, Sanarium, Dampfbad, Erlebnisduschen und einen Eisbrunnen als Gesamtprogramm zum Verwöhnen und Entspannen.

verified_facts.text: The spa name Vita Borni means 'life from the spring, spring of life'.
verified_facts.excerpt: «Vita Borni» bedeutet «Leben aus der Quelle, Quell des Lebens».

verified_facts.text: The spa uses products from Alpeor and Niance, two luxury brands drawing on Alpine plants and modern science.
verified_facts.excerpt: Das Spa verwendet Produkte von Alpeor und Niance, zwei Luxusmarken, die sich der Kraft der Alpinen Pflanzenwelt und modernster Wissenschaft bedienen.

verified_facts.text: Guests choose between rooms and luxury suites, and whether to wake up with a view of the Matterhorn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wählen Sie zwischen unseren geräumigen Zimmern und Luxussuiten und ob Sie mit Blick auf das legendäre Matterhorn aufwachen möchten.

verified_facts.text: Every room has its own personal ski locker in the ski room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Zusätzlich verfügt jedes Zimmer im Skiraum über ein persönliches Schliessfach für die Skis.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite has a king-size bed, separate shower and bath, and the scent of local Swiss stone pine wood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegante Junior Suite mit Kingsize Bett, separater Dusche und Bad und dem entspannenden Duft des lokalen Arvenholzes.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Suite Matterhorn View has separate dining and living areas with a fireplace and a balcony with a view of the Matterhorn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Separater Ess- und Wohnbereich mit Kamin und einem Balkon mit fantastischem Blick auf das Matterhorn.

verified_facts.text: The Chalet Suite is in Swiss chalet style with a king-size bed, a fireplace and a balcony looking over the village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grosszügige Suite im Schweizer Chalet-Stil mit Kingsize Bett sowie Kamin und Balkon und Blick auf das Dorf.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tierfreundlich

verified_facts.text: Chef Stefan Lunse leads Alpine Gourmet Prato Borni, combining Alpine roots with international flair and produce from the Valais and around the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seine Küche vereint alpine Verwurzelung mit internationalem Esprit – geprägt von Kreativität, Präzision und ausgesuchten Produkten aus dem Wallis und der Welt.

verified_facts.text: The Lusi terrace in front of the hotel has a direct view of the Matterhorn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Die Lusi Terrasse vor dem Hotel ist der sonnigste Ort im Dorf und bietet direkten Blick aufs Matterhorn.

verified_facts.text: Saycheese! serves Swiss cheese specialities fondue and raclette.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entdecken Sie unsere bekannten Schweizer Käsespezialitäten Fondue und Raclette.

verified_facts.text: The Smokers Lounge offers cigars from Cuba and the Dominican Republic with selected whiskies and cognacs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ganztags geöffnet, mit einer Auswahl von Zigarren aus Kuba und der Domenikanischen Republik mit auserlesenen Whiskies und Cognacs.
